mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 9.5% over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 9.5% and stays below for three months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained unemployment above 9.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained RSAFS declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 2% over three months signals improving manufacturing output and economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises above 2% and stays above for three months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of sustained INDPRO rises above 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% over three months signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% and stays above for three months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 1% over three months signals improving labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises above 1% and stays above for three months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of sustained PAYEMS rises above 1% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) above 5% over three months signals improving housing demand and construction activity, which boosts related equities and consumer confidence, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises above 5% and stays above for three months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of sustained HOUST rises above 5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% over three months signals accelerating inflation, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises above 3% and stays above for three months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained CPIAUCSL rises above 3% (t-test p > 0.05).
